protected_assets.description: Global managed Capability catalog and active immutable Skill packages
Tool authorization confirmation health platform policy and persisted permission intent

trusted_assumptions.description: Current user account, OS kernel and deterministic gate are trusted

in_scope_failures.description: Existing and new Sessions receive different Skill or Tool catalogs
Universal Tool discoverability bypasses execution policy
Production traffic is wired through a legacy catalog seam
Automatic permission bypasses mandatory confirmation or overwrites explicit intent

maximum_acceptable_impact: A failure may reject the current Run but must not bypass policy or overwrite explicit permission intent.
